items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: You work with a wonderful guy like Jimmy Rushing or Jack Teagarden or somebody singing, there was no problems at all

ctx.x: Yeah, working with singers can be a little nerve wracking occasionally. Especially if you hit a chord they don’t particularly like and it throws them off, and you get one of those looks.

I always thought for the most part that you couldn’t compare singers with musicians, you know what I mean? You work with a wonderful guy like Jimmy Rushing or Jack Teagarden or somebody singing, there was no problems at all, it was right in there you know. But it didn’t always work you know.
Yeah. I think it probably helps when a singer is a player of an instrument.
